snippet.title: Octillery VS. Collection Trailer
snippet.description:
The trailer for a game I've been putting my heart and soul into! Octillery VS. Collection! A collection of refined, polished, and updated versions of games in the Octillery VS. trilogy! Includes Octillery VS. Xi Jinping, Octillery VS. Putin, and Jonathan's Adventure 2! It also includes one new exclusive game, Octillery VS. Yi Long Musk!

https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/4513610
